map.智能指针该怎么选？: Which smart pointer should I use?
map.独占所有权用 std::unique_ptr（零额外开销、可移动），共享所有权用: Use std::unique_ptr for exclusive ownership (zero extra overhead, movable), std::shared_ptr for shared ownership (with reference-count overhead and the risk of cycles), and std::weak_ptr to observe without owning and to break cycles. Start with unique_ptr by default and only move up to shared ownership when you genuinely need it.
